headline.purpose: Current 光域 or review workspace; 17px mobile.

label.purpose: Primary action and compact control names.

p5r-display.purpose: P5R only: locally hosted OFL Barlow Condensed Black Italic, aliased Royal Display; italic English paper-cut poster. 76px compact, 62px mobile.

p5r-message.purpose: P5R only: native system Chinese task statement; 22px compact and 19px mobile.

p5r-metric.purpose: P5R only: italic Royal Display scan-strip numbers; confirmation metrics enlarge to 36px.

p5r-review-title.purpose: P5R only: bold italic system heading after every generated preview, including empty results; 22px compact and 20px mobile.

shadows.name: overlay-dark
shadows.purpose: Menus and confirmation sheet in dark 光域.

shadows.name: overlay-light
shadows.purpose: Menus and confirmation sheet in light 光域.

shadows.name: search-focus
shadows.purpose: Search focus-within treatment alongside sea-glass border.

shadows.name: p5r-overlay
shadows.purpose: P5R only: menus and square confirmation sheet; review remains flat.

shadows.name: p5r-search-focus
shadows.purpose: P5R only: search focus outline; standard keyboard focus is currentColor with 4px offset.

motion.name: p5r-snap
motion.purpose: P5R only: finite swipe, paper paste, review arrival and control movement. Source-defined timing; not independently measured in captures.

motion.name: p5r-swipe
motion.purpose: P5R only: paper then ink passes across viewport on appearance entry; pointer-events none; lifecycle class clears after 840ms.

motion.name: p5r-paste
motion.purpose: P5R only: finite perspective paper arrival; appearance entry or explicit homepage replay.

motion.name: p5r-review
motion.purpose: P5R only: generated preview enters from slight translation and rotation; lifecycle class clears after 640ms.

motion.name: p5r-controls
motion.purpose: P5R only: 3px rule slide and 2px action lift. System or stored reduced motion disables transitions and animations and hides cuts.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Background, border, color and shadow changes.

motion.name: review-arrive
motion.purpose: 光域 review entry with full motion only.

motion.name: persona-pointer
motion.value: stiffness 110; damping 16; capped frame delta 50ms; paint interval >= 32ms
motion.purpose: Flat profile cutout parallax and P5R shallow poster tilt; controls retain their layout.

motion.name: persona-lifecycle
motion.value: P5R: 6s entry / 8s replay / 2.2s input; visible P3R water continuous; DPR <= 1.4
motion.purpose: Clipped hero surface: P3R broad water reflections at 224x112/~30fps and two opposite circular scene reveals (460ms growth, 55ms stagger, clear at 515ms); P5R black/white five-point comic impact. Observe the unclipped stage. Pause, reduced motion, offscreen, hidden and review release masks and stop frames.

motion.name: persona-pause
motion.purpose: Homepage replay/pause controls, minimum target36px. Pause persists across P3R/P5R and cancels replay; controls and canvas hidden in review.

motion.name: lightfield-settle
motion.purpose: Three native scene choices; pause/reduced/hidden/review/theme change cancel fades. At most three pulses.

motion.name: lightfield-render-budget
motion.purpose: WebGL2 slow ambient only in the visible home view; Canvas2D idle stops. Pause, reduced motion, review, hidden, forced colors and context loss suspend drawing. SVG keeps a projected still.

components.name: Spatial Scene Controls
components.description: The real background is procedural WebGL2 / Canvas2D, not an embedded SVG specimen. Three independent spatial topologies share native controls.

narrative.northStar: A Library You Can Step Into
narrative.overview: Full-window original triangular relief, braided particle currents and a resonant mesh under legible graphite operations. Ships in v1.1.2; earlier v1.1.0/v1.1.1 releases were withdrawn.
keyCharacteristics: Three scene choices with mesh / point / line topology, saved locally.
Actual GPU depth and material detail with Canvas2D / SVG fallback.
Native typography and readable tonal operation panels.
Review freezes and dims scenery; explicit write guards remain.

rules.name: The Wayfinding Rule
rules.body: Use sea-glass for action, selection and focus; keep iris and copper within the decorative light field.

rules.name: The Alternate Boundary Rule
rules.body: Apply P5R red, paper cuts and display typography only inside the selected P5R appearance; 光域 keeps its sea-glass light-field identity.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Use the existing system stack throughout 光域, including its invitation and brand subtitle.

rules.name: The Quiet Frame Rule
rules.body: Keep operating panels stationary; pause or reduce motion on request and freeze/dim scenery during review.

rules.name: The Persona Motion Rule
rules.body: Simple flat fan profile cutouts replace detailed key art. P3R uses blue/white, broad underwater light and two circular windows revealing the hero; P5R uses black/white/red and a sharp comic star impact. Effects are clipped to the hero, away from controls. Pause/reduced motion, hidden windows, offscreen scenes and generated review stop frames; visible P3R water may continue at idle.

dos: Do use sea-glass for action, selection and visible keyboard focus.
Do keep 光域 typography native and leave an open text area over the spatial field.
Do preserve disabled states, semantic status colors and the explicit preview/write distinction.
Do retain offline rendering, a matching SVG still, pause/change-field controls and reduced-motion behavior.
Do scope P5R styling to its selected alternate, retain its local display font and show review after every generated result, including empty plans.
donts: Don't restore the superseded centered square-grid composition as 光域's identity.
Don't copy Code-Codex or React Bits source or artwork assets.
Don't retain light-field animation behind generated review or schedule continuous idle or hidden frames.
Don't promote tiny incidental labels into a reusable density standard.
Don't require external services or a Node runtime for the desktop interface, or introduce game logos or extracted game assets. Keep requested fan portraits locally bundled with provenance.
